title: The Last Locker
author: Ines Kavanagh
blurb: Oscar Villalobos, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before the last game of the season.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
